_warranty.jsonld: Phone and tablet repairs carry a lifetime warranty on parts and labor. Batteries carry a 1-year warranty, and console repairs carry a 1-year warranty on all parts. If a part fails outside of physical damage, we replace it free — and screen repairs include one free re-repair if the screen cracks again within 12 months.
